title: Byte latent patch and entropy chunker
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for segmenting byte streams into lossless variable-length patches at conditional Shannon entropy spikes and allocating downstream compute proportional to cumulative information surprise.
boundaries: DynamicByteEntropyPatcher segments byte streams losslessly whenever predictive conditional Shannon entropy H(b_t | context) exceeds global_entropy_threshold or delta_spike_threshold within grid-clamped [min_patch_bytes, max_patch_bytes] bounds.
SurpriseProportionalBudgetAllocator apportions downstream context or inspection slots proportional to cumulative patch surprise rather than raw byte length.
All entropy thresholds, context orders, patch byte ceilings and Dirichlet prior concentrations resolve from default_grid_spec.json under ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for segmenting byte streams into lossless variable-length patches at conditional Shannon entropy spikes and allocating downstream compute proportional to cumulative information surprise

value.lets_workers: Segment raw byte streams into lossless variable-length patches driven by conditional byte Shannon entropy H(b_t | context) and entropy delta spikes, allocate downstream inspection slots proportional to cumulative information surprise rather than byte length and re-synchronize patch boundaries after byte insertions or corruptions.

flow.when: Segment raw byte streams into variable-length patches at conditional entropy spikes and verify exact byte reconstruction.
Apportion downstream inspection slots across patches by cumulative information surprise and benchmark perturbation re-synchronization against fixed-stride chunks.
Independently verify lossless byte reconstruction, surprise focus gain, perturbation re-synchronization and ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate conformance.

value.worked_example: 111-byte stream segmented into 9 variable-length patches (4 to 30 bytes, 100% lossless reconstruction), concentrating 90.62% of inspection slots on high-entropy patches (vs 21.88% by byte length) and preserving 77.78% of patches after a prefix byte insertion (vs 14.29% for 8-byte fixed stride) in test_entropy_byte_patcher.py.

nouns.title: Guardrail: dynamic byte patches must concatenate byte-for-byte identically to the source stream within grid length bounds
nouns.category_reason: Prevents dropped bytes, UTF-8 corruption or unbounded patch growth during adaptive byte chunking.

value.rule: DynamicByteEntropyPatcher enforces min_patch_bytes and max_patch_bytes ceilings from default_grid_spec.json on interior patches and requires exact SHA-256 byte-stream reconstruction across concatenated patches.
value.how_it_is_checked: DynamicByteEntropyPatcher.segment_stream verifies reconstructed == raw bytes and records stream_sha256.

nouns.title: Guardrail: compute slot apportionment follows cumulative surprise and operational code contains zero inline magic literals
nouns.category_reason: Prevents wasting context budget on predictable boilerplate padding while enforcing declarative grid governance.

value.rule: SurpriseProportionalBudgetAllocator apportions exact integer slot budgets via largest-remainder weighting on cumulative_surprise_bits rather than byte length, and ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate rejects inline magic literals.
value.how_it_is_checked: test_entropy_byte_patcher.py verifies exact budget conservation, positive high-entropy focus gain, boundary re-synchronization and zero AST magic-literal violations.

verbs.title: Segment raw byte streams into lossless variable-length patches at conditional entropy spikes

slots.name: byte_stream_bundle
slots.description: Pin of calibration byte motifs and candidate byte stream.

steps: Resolve global_entropy_threshold, delta_spike_threshold and [min_patch_bytes, max_patch_bytes] from default_grid_spec.json.
Evaluate backed-off byte Markov conditional entropy at each byte offset, emit patches on entropy spikes and confirm exact byte reconstruction.

acceptance.check: Concatenated patch bytes equal the input stream identically and interior patch lengths respect [min_patch_bytes, max_patch_bytes].

verbs.title: Allocate downstream compute slots by cumulative surprise and benchmark perturbation re-synchronization

verbs.outcome: Surprise-proportional slot schedule, high-entropy focus gain and perturbation re-synchronization metrics.

slots.description: Pin of clean and perturbed byte streams for surprise allocation and shift-resync comparison.

steps: Apportion total_inspection_budget across segmented patches proportional to cumulative_surprise_bits and compare against byte-length weighting.
Measure preserved patch multiset overlap between clean and perturbed streams relative to fixed-stride chunking.

acceptance.check: Surprise-proportional allocation assigns higher budget share to high-entropy patches than byte-length weighting and dynamic patching outperforms fixed-stride chunking under byte insertions.
